## Copilot review overview ### 🟡 Changes recommended Request logging must redact credentials, and one suite should use the shared launcher. **Review effort:** Lite **Findings:** 1
Open (2) - [Redact credentials before logging request URLs](#discussion_r701) · New - [Use the shared launcher in the skipped suite](#discussion_r702) · New
What changed in this PR Adds request tracking to the end-to-end tests and logs in-flight requests after a failure. | File | Summary | |---|---| | `test/e2e/lib/browser.mjs` | Implements request tracking and logging. **Critical (1 vote):** full URLs may expose credentials in query parameters and must be redacted. | | `test/e2e/beacon-test.js` | **Nit (2 votes):** still launches the browser directly instead of using the shared launcher. | | `docs/testing.md` | Documents the diagnostic output. |
